_comment: DEMO suite 'airportdb' — airline operations over the airportdb sample held in PostgreSQL, served to S3. DOMAINS: airportdb (system postgres, model airportdb, data l = `tdx-domain create-data --size 1000`, ~100k bookings) and s3 (system s3, no model — the serving bucket prefix). INGEST: airport_src reads flight/booking/passenger/airline/airport/airport_geo with one transactional PostgresSrc publisher (six queries, LIMIT 100 each, one consistent snapshot), SCHEDULED by trigger_by=CronTrigger every 5 minutes at minute 0 (UTC) — the suite's manual trigger coexists with it for the first batch. MARTS: airport_marts is a connection-less @transformer collection (group 'marts') building bookings_enriched, high_value_bookings, flight_roster and airport_directory with the Tabsdata TableFrame API only (join/filter/select/sort/rename — row-preserving; no polars). SERVE: airport_s3 writes each mart to a parquet object under airportdb/ in the s3 domain. Only the publisher is triggered; the rest cascade by @NEW. Functions in functions/airportdb.py. Run: `tdx-xp oneshot --suite demo/airportdb`.
